subject: Aster Medical — Site commissioning & tenant activation (edge facility)
messages:

To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 12:02:00 -0400
Subject: Private deploy site commissioning — Aster Medical Edge (next steps)

Hi Jonas and Kimberly,

Thanks again for walking the team through the private deployment options last week. We're ready to move the Edge site at our Cambridge facility into the commissioning phase. Attached is our preliminary network diagram and the on-call roster you asked for.

High-level asks from our side before we schedule the activation window:
- Confirm Redwood's recommended maintenance window (we prefer overnight Tue->Wed)
- Final list of IPs and FQDNs to allow on our firewall (ingress and egress)
- Any special BGP peering or ASN requirements (we plan to use transit via ACME Connect)
- KMS/HSM integration notes: we will provide a key in our KMS but need to know the expected key rotation policy and whether Redwood will store any key material

We're aiming for a staging validation on the week of May 22; full activation target the week after. Please review the attached diagram and send the activation checklist you use for site commissioning.

Regards,
Maria Gutierrez
Head of IT Operations | Aster Medical

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Maria Gutierrez <maria.gutierrez@astermed.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 14:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deploy site commissioning — Aster Medical Edge (next steps)

Hi Maria — thanks, this looks good.

On Tue, 9 May 2028 at 12:02 PM Maria Gutierrez <maria.gutierrez@astermed.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for walking the team through the private deployment options last week.
> Attached is our preliminary network diagram and the on-call roster you asked for.

I attached our site-commissioning-checklist (v1) for the activation workstream — it's the checklist our deployment engineers use for edge activations. Key items to confirm from your side (I've highlighted the fields we need you to populate):
- Network ranges (CIDR): control-plane, data-plane, management. We need exact CIDRs and whether they're public or private.
- NAT / Egress: do you require a dedicated SNAT IP or are you fine using shared egress through your transit?
- DNS: please provide the authoritative DNS entries and internal resolution plan for the tenant (split-horizon? resolver IPs?)
- NTP/time sync policy and allowed NTP servers
- KMS: we support external KMS via our KMS proxy. Provide KMS endpoint URL and the key resource name; we will not store raw key material.
- Firewall ports: minimal set below — please confirm open/filtered sides:
  - 443 TCP outbound to api.redwood.example.com (model/control plane)
  - 50051 TCP inbound (gRPC) from our collector IPs (listed in checklist)
  - 22 TCP restricted to scheduled maintenance IPs (bastion)
  - UDP/123 NTP to your approved NTP pool
- Monitoring & logs: will you forward syslog to our collector or will Redwood fetch via pull? If push, provide syslog endpoint and credentials.

Proposed maintenance window: Tue 23:00 - Wed 03:00 local (Cambridge). We can compress some steps but prefer that window for a clean cutover and traceroutes.

I've included Ben to schedule validation runs and to include the activation-runbook and a short preflight script.

Next steps: please fill the checklist fields and return signed AUP (attached) if legal signoff is complete. If any of the networking items above conflict with your compliance needs, flag them and we'll get security involved.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: site-commissioning-checklist-v1.xlsx (4KB)

From: Maria Gutierrez <maria.gutierrez@astermed.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 09:06:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deploy site commissioning — Aster Medical Edge (next steps)

Jonas — thanks for the checklist. We've filled several fields inline in the attached network-diagram update and answers file. Quick answers below:

- CIDRs: control-plane 10.10.0.0/22 (private), data-plane 10.20.0.0/21 (private), management 198.51.100.0/27 (public SNAT)
- Egress: we prefer a dedicated SNAT (public) IP for auditability — IP: 198.51.100.12
- ASN/BGP: we'll peer with ASN 64512; we do not require dynamic BGP for the initial deployment — static routes are acceptable for now
- DNS: split-horizon. Internal resolver 10.10.0.2; we will create internal records under internal.astermed.local for the tenant
- NTP: we use govtime-1.ourpool.example (UDP/123) and are happy to open NTP to that host
- KMS: key endpoint: https://kms.astermed.example/v1/keys/aster-edge-01 — we will provide a read-only service account; keys are rotated quarterly. We will upload signed AUP to DocuSign for signature today.

We've attached the updated diagram and oncall list. Two notes:
1) We need to confirm whether Redwood requires outbound webhook ports to be opened (we saw mention of 50051 gRPC); if that is outbound from the tenant to Redwood or inbound.
2) Can Redwood support our audit requirement to log all administrative actions to our SIEM (Log destination: splunk-heavy.astermed.internal:6514)?

If you can confirm the webhook direction and provide the collector IPs, we'll lock the maintenance window.

Thanks,
Maria

Attachments: network-diagram.pdf (updated), oncall-contacts.csv (updated), astermed-signed-AUP.pdf (coming via DocuSign)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Maria Gutierrez <maria.gutierrez@astermed.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deploy site commissioning — Aster Medical Edge (next steps)

Maria — great, this is really helpful. Quick answers and next steps:

- Collector / webhook direction: the 50051 gRPC listener is inbound to your VPC from our managed collector (we push telemetry to the tenant over a secured channel). We'll provide the collector IPs and TLS fingerprint prior to the maintenance window.
- Splunk/SIEM: we support syslog-forwarding and TLS syslog push; we'll configure our agent to push admin/audit streams to splunk-heavy.astermed.internal:6514. Please confirm port 6514 TCP is open to the collector.
- KMS: thanks for the endpoint. Redwood will create a service account binding; we never store private key material. Quarterly rotation is fine — we'll update our rotation calendar to align.
- SNAT: we will use the dedicated SNAT IP you provided.

Schedule: Can we lock the staging validation for Tue, 22 May 23:30 - 01:30 (local) and the full activation Wed, 24 May 00:00 - 04:00? Those are slightly offset to accommodate our engineers and your ops team. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and the preflight runbook.

Attached is a short activation-runbook (text) with the preflight checklist that we'll run during the staging window. Also attaching a copy of the AUP we need signed — if you can confirm DocuSign completed, we can mark legal as green.

Thanks — looping Kimberly for compliance signoff and to confirm the Runbook steps.

-ben

Ben Carter
Deployment Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: activation-runbook.md (2KB), redwood-AUP-copy.pdf (1KB)
